'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Philippe Dubreuil LS Jabba's Prize''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Philippe Dubreuil]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name worlds day 2 light[1]. Typed Holotable 'worlds day 2 light[1]'; handwritten Philippe Dubreuil Day 2 Light. Jabba's Prize/Jabba's Prize sits in the shield block (Light shield, not the Dark character). Page 2: A Good Blaster At Your Side, Wokling (V), Imperial Navigation Charts, Infiltration/Unlikely Allies, plus handwritten 'Yavin 4 Sentry (V)' (card is Yavin Sentry (V)). Kyle Katarn and Errant Venture each have an (AI) copy. He Can Go About His Business has no typed (V). Reserve qty 60 excluding shields.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
